breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions (Dirichlet and Periodic). The ground truth removed the periodic condition. The agent correctly identified the conflict and generated a specification that only includes the Dirichlet boundary conditions, completely omitting the incorrect periodic instruction, thus aligning with the ground truth.
